label: PF Backlog 296
title: Media chunking + markdown asset-ref resolution: modality-native map-reduce over asset children (tiles/segments/frames) (BI-PF-0281)
body: Follow-on to BI-PF-0280. When media parts exceed the per-call budget, map-reduce over asset children (tiles/segments/frames) reusing the _call_llm_chunked shape; resolve markdown asset refs (![..](assets/..), AS-*) in upstream artifacts into asset ids -> summaries/parts. Reuses asset_store._split children + multimodal.
